_about: Curated general over-the-counter options for common, non-emergency adult self-care symptoms. Every option, caution and warning sign below is taken from the listed source pages (checked 2026-11-23 / 2026-11-24). Items marked rule="medresolve" are conservative MedResolve rules, not claims from a source. This is general information to discuss with a pharmacist, not a prescription. Clinician review of this file is pending.

S5.title: Dengue and severe dengue: WHO fact sheet

S14.title: Oxymetazoline Nasal Spray: MedlinePlus Drug Information

options.use: one 500 mg or 650 mg tablet every 6 hours if needed, after food
options.limit: Do not take more than 4 tablets of 650 mg in 24 hours (MedResolve uses a lower limit than the label maximum of 4,000 mg a day from all sources), and do not take it together with cold or flu products that also contain paracetamol.

cautions.text: ask a doctor before taking paracetamol, because of your liver-related record

avoid.text: Avoid ibuprofen and aspirin until dengue is ruled out: in dengue they can increase the risk of bleeding.
avoid.history_text: This matters more for you because you have had dengue before, and a second dengue infection carries a greater risk of severe dengue.

see_doctor.text: the fever lasts more than 2 days: see a doctor and ask for a dengue test (NS1 / blood count)
see_doctor.rule: medresolve (earlier than the label's 3 days because of the dengue risk)

see_doctor.text: the fever gets worse or lasts more than 3 days, or new symptoms appear

warning_signs.text: Go to a doctor the same day if you notice severe stomach pain, vomiting again and again, fast breathing, bleeding from the gums or nose, blood in vomit or stool, or you feel very weak, restless or very thirsty.

options.use: follow the dose on the package label; you can start when symptoms begin or when your period starts and keep taking it for a few days
options.limit: A heating pad or hot water bottle on the lower abdomen, exercise or a hot bath can also help.

cautions.text: ibuprofen should not be taken with stomach ulcers, bleeding problems or liver disease

options.limit: Do not take more than 4 tablets of 650 mg in 24 hours (MedResolve uses a lower limit than the label maximum of 4,000 mg a day from all sources), and do not take it together with cold or flu products that also contain paracetamol.

your cramps suddenly get worse, or you are over 25 and get severe cramps for the first time

warning_signs.text: Get medical help the same day for very heavy bleeding, fainting, or severe pain with fever.

options.use: one 500 mg or 650 mg tablet every 6 hours if needed, after food; it relieves mild to moderate pain until you see a dentist
options.limit: Do not take more than 4 tablets of 650 mg in 24 hours (MedResolve uses a lower limit than the label maximum of 4,000 mg a day from all sources), and do not take it together with cold or flu products that also contain paracetamol.

cautions.text: ask a doctor before taking paracetamol, because of your liver-related record

see_doctor.text: the pain lasts: a dentist needs to find the cause, since treatment (such as a filling or root canal) depends on the problem

warning_signs.text: See a dentist or doctor the same day for swelling of the face or jaw, fever, or trouble swallowing or breathing.

options.use: one 500 mg or 650 mg tablet every 6 hours if needed, after food; rest the injured area, put ice on it and use a compression bandage
options.limit: Do not take more than 4 tablets of 650 mg in 24 hours (MedResolve uses a lower limit than the label maximum of 4,000 mg a day from all sources), and do not take it together with cold or flu products that also contain paracetamol.

cautions.text: ask a doctor before taking paracetamol, because of your liver-related record

avoid.history_text: Do not use ibuprofen or similar painkillers (NSAIDs) without a doctor's advice: they can cause stomach ulcers and bleeding and need caution with kidney or heart disease, which your records mention

see_doctor.text: you cannot put weight on the injured part, it looks deformed, or the pain and swelling do not improve within a few days

warning_signs.text: Get medical help right away for numbness, a cold or blue limb, or a joint that looks out of place.

fungal.label: fungal skin infection (ringworm, jock itch, athlete's foot)

options.use: wash and dry the area, then apply a thin layer as the package label directs
options.limit: Jock itch should improve over 2 weeks and ringworm or athlete's foot over 4 weeks; it does not work on the scalp or nails.

see_doctor.text: the rash does not improve in that time, or gets worse at any time

warning_signs.text: See a doctor if the rash spreads quickly, becomes painful, swollen or oozing, or you have a fever.

options.use: use it every 3 to 4 days for up to 8 weeks, then as needed to control dandruff
options.limit: Follow the directions on the package.

see_doctor.text: the dandruff does not improve after 8 weeks, or the scalp becomes red, painful or starts losing hair in patches

warning_signs.text: Stop using it and get help if you have a rash, swelling or trouble breathing after using it.

options.use: one 10 mg tablet once a day
options.limit: It may make you drowsy: do not drive until you know how it affects you, and avoid alcohol with it.

cautions.text: ask a doctor before taking cetirizine, because of your kidney- or liver-related record

see_doctor.text: the symptoms do not improve, or you develop fever, face pain or wheezing

warning_signs.text: Get help immediately if you have trouble breathing or swelling of the face, lips or throat.

options.use: one 10 mg tablet once a day; cold compresses, moisturising lotion and lukewarm baths also help
options.limit: It may make you drowsy: do not drive until you know how it affects you, and avoid alcohol with it.

cautions.text: ask a doctor before taking cetirizine, because of your kidney- or liver-related record

options.use: apply a thin layer to the itchy area as the package label directs
options.limit: Use it only on small areas of skin and for a short time.

see_doctor.text: the itching is severe, does not go away after a few weeks, or has no clear cause

warning_signs.text: Get emergency help for trouble breathing or swelling of the face, lips or throat after a bite or sting (a severe allergic reaction).

options.use: follow the dose on the package label; antacids neutralise the stomach acid that causes heartburn
options.limit: Antacids can change how your body absorbs other medicines, so take other medicines at a different time.

cautions.text: talk to a doctor or pharmacist before taking antacids regularly

see_doctor.text: you have heartburn more than twice a week (this may be GERD)

warning_signs.text: Crushing chest pain could be a heart attack: get help immediately.

options.limit: As you feel better, eat soft, bland food.

options.use: for sudden (acute) diarrhoea; follow the dose on the package label
options.limit: Never take more, more often or for longer than the package says: too much can cause serious heart problems.
options.skip_text: Loperamide is not suggested because you mention fever, blood or mucus in the stool, or black stools; see a doctor.

warning_signs.text: See a doctor the same day for blood in the stool, black stools, high fever, severe stomach pain, or signs of dehydration such as very little urine or dizziness.

options.use: mix the powder with a full glass (240 ml) of liquid right before taking it, and drink at least another glass
options.limit: Do not take it for longer than 1 week unless a doctor advises. Fruit, vegetables, whole grains, plenty of water and exercise also help.

options.use: follow the dose on the package label; it temporarily relieves a cough from a cold or flu but does not treat its cause
options.limit: Many cough syrups also contain paracetamol: do not take a separate paracetamol tablet on top of one that does.

see_doctor.text: your cough does not get better within 7 days, goes away and comes back, or comes with fever, rash or headache
your cough lasts longer than 2 to 3 weeks (a chronic cough)

warning_signs.text: Get help right away if you cough up blood, have trouble breathing, or have chest pain.

options.use: use them in the nose as needed; rest, plenty of fluids, a humidifier and gargling with warm salt water also help
options.limit: There is no cure for a cold, but these make you feel better while it goes away.

options.use: follow the package label; it relieves a blocked nose from colds and allergies
